_doc: Claims known to be wrong. helpers/canonical-facts.py fails when a line under `paths` matches `pattern` (case-insensitive) and no `allow` regex matches the same line. Matching is per line: a correction on the next line does not excuse a hit, so keep the correcting wording on the same line, or add it to `allow` — the allow list is the escape hatch for legitimate uses (e.g. rel=next for browser prefetch). Allow lists are deliberately broad (a negation anywhere on the line suppresses the hit): this is a tripwire for restated claims, not a parser. Each entry carries the reason and the primary source.

facts.why: INP replaced FID as a Core Web Vital in March 2024 — FID is never a current metric or threshold
HowTo rich results were removed in 2023-09 and FAQ rich results are limited to well-known government and health sites since 2023-08
Google stopped using rel=next/prev as an indexing signal in 2019
Google-Extended controls Gemini training and grounding only; it does not affect Google Search or AI Overviews
Google removed the sitelinks search box from results in November 2024
